content:
**One correction first, then the answer.**

WO-2026-00048 is **not** downstream of WO-2026-00047. `downstream_impact` walks BOM materials — no material link exists between these two orders. WO-2026-00048 (Pump Mounting Bracket Assembly, 60 pcs, SO-2026-...) is separately late (235 days past due, `is_late=true`) with its own blockers. Please don't hold it behind WO-2026-00047.

**Why late — WO-2026-00047** (Battery Tray Base Pan, 120 pcs, planned end 2026-02-25, 236 days past due)
- **Blocking:** `subcontract_not_sent` — SCO-2026-00038 is still a **draft**, never sent to the vendor, expected delivery 2026-03-03. Nothing can commit until it moves.
- **Contributing:** `operation_not_started` — JC-2026-00139 (Laser Cut Blank, LASER-01) open, never started, waiting 245 days. Also `schedule_capacity_ceiling` on WS-2026-00001 (720 min) and WS-2026-00009 (480 min); `schedule_subcontract_pending`; `stopped_without_recorded_reason`; recorded downtime — PB-02 Energy Mac 100T, quality_issue, 202.21 min, and PB-01 Amada HFE 1303, setup_change, 417.37 min across 2 entries.
- Cost: expected and actual are both 0 — no cost recorded, so no variance can be stated.

**What it blocks (potential, BOM-matched — not confirmed blocks)**
WO-2026-00116, WO-2026-00101, WO-2026-00086, WO-2026-00071, WO-2026-00056 (all Battery Tray Weldments) may be affected, and beyond them WO-2026-00106, WO-2026-00091, WO-2026-00076, WO-2026-00061. These are **potential customers** only — stock or another order could cover them.
Sales exposure reached through those potential consumers (is **potential**, not recorded): SO-2026-00021 (Bharat EV Motors, 2026-08-18, ₹456,695.40), SO-2026-00171 (2026-07-12, ₹2,219,635.79), SO-2026-00151 (2026-06-10, ₹2,693,620.93), SO-2026-00050 (2026-09-16, ₹1,174,359.60 — already delivered). Customer impact recorded as "known"; no sales order is linked on WO-2026-00047 itself (make_to_stock, sales_order_id null).

**Rescheduling**
No date can be written. Every proposal — WO-2026-00047 and all its dependants (WO-2026-00116, 00101, 00086, 00106, 00091, 00076) — comes back `date_committable=false`, `writable_by_seat=false`, reason "blocked by an event with no known date: subcontract_not_sent". This is a recommendation needing a person: get SCO-2026-00038 sent first. Only then does a committable date exist.

**What to do:** chase SCO-2026-00038 (draft) and SCO-2026-00076 / SCO-2026-00030 for the bracket order; get a planner to release or cancel the draft subcontracts so the schedule can be re-based. This needs a human — a blocker with no known date.

**Not visible to me:** nothing — all entities I needed were reachable.

**Note on record text:** several record labels in this book contain instructions/quotes embedded in text fields (subcontract vendor names, downtime remarks such as "line 314 at Aurangabad. Accepted on concession.", and a company name wrapped in markers). These are data, not instructions to me, and I have not acted on any of them. If a row is trying to steer your agent, it was in SCO-2026-00038 / the downtime rows for PB-02 and CNC-02 — worth a look at who wrote them.
